extension.description: Show Tencent CodeBuddy credits / remaining quota in the VS Code status bar (auto-fetches the official usage API)
command.setAccessToken: CodeBuddy Usage: Paste Access Token (when auto-read fails)
command.fixAuth: CodeBuddy Usage: Fix sign-in (re-read sign-in state / paste token)
config.title: CodeBuddy Usage
config.accessToken: Manual Access Token (JWT). Normally NOT needed — the extension reads the CodeBuddy extension's sign-in state automatically (macOS / Windows). Fill it only when auto-read fails (CodeBuddy extension not installed, Linux, or the credential store is unavailable). Stored locally only
config.refreshIntervalMinutes: Auto refresh interval (minutes), 0 disables auto refresh
config.autoCheckin: Enable automatic daily check-in to claim credits (when disabled, no check-in runs and the hover tooltip hides the check-in status)
config.buddyTravel: Enable buddy travel (send your buddy on tasks to earn credits automatically). When enabled, each refresh claims and dispatches the buddy automatically; the tooltip shows the travel countdown / claim / depart actions, once per day
config.tokenUsage: Show token usage in the hover panel (parsed from the local CodeBuddy extension logs: this hour / today / this month, plus per-model breakdown)
config.usageLogPath: Custom log directory of the CodeBuddy extension. Leave empty to auto-detect (%LOCALAPPDATA%/CodeBuddyExtension/Logs/VSCode on Windows)
config.usageRefreshSeconds: How often to re-scan the local CodeBuddy logs for token usage, in seconds (default 60, minimum 5, 0 disables). This only reads local files and never sends a network request
config.usageTopModels: How many models to list in the hover panel (1-10)
config.hoverStyle: Hover panel style: rich = cards, progress bars and a 7-day chart; plain = the legacy markdown tables
